title.zh: 工作场所安全与健康修正命令 2013
title.en: WORKPLACE SAFETY AND HEALTH AMENDMENT ORDER 2013

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-95-2013-WORKPLACE-SAFETY-AND-HEALTH-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2013.pdf》（7 页），本次切分 24 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Workplace Safety and Health (Amendment) 2013 and shall commence on the same date as the Workplace Safety and of section 2 of S 44/2009.
Section 2 of the Workplace Safety and Health Order, 2009, in this Order to as the principal Order, is repealed and the following new section therefor - "Application of Order.

Section 5 of the principal Order is amended by repealing subsection (2) and by substituting the following new subsection therefor - "(2) Subject to this section, "factory" means any premises within which persons are employed in any of the following processes - fa) the handling, sorting, packing, storing, altering, repa1nng, construction, processing or manufacturing of any goods or products;

(b) the handling, sorting, packing, storing, processing, manufacturing, or in relation to, of any hazardous substance; fc) the repair, construction or manufacturing of any vessel or vehicle; fd) any building operation or work of engineering construction; {e) the operation or maintenance of any facility or system related to the provision of any public utility.". Amendment of section 12.

Section 12 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection {3) - fa} in paragraph (e), by deleting the fullstop and by substituting a semicolon fb} by adding the following new paragraph - "ff} the provision and maintenance of plant and systems of work that are, so far as is reasonably practicable, safe and without risks to health.". of section 27.

Section 27 of the principal Order is amended by repealing subsection (2) and by substituting the following new subsection therefor - "(2) made under subsection (1) may apply to a person who is an exempt person at work specified in the Sixth Schedule.". of section 49.
Section 49 of the principal Order is amended, in paragraph fb}, by deleting "$500,000" from the first line and by substituting "$10,000,000" therefor. of section 50.
Section 50 of the principal Order is amended, in sub-paragraph (ii), by deleting "$1,000,000" from the second line and by substituting "$20,000,000" of section 61.
Section 61 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (1), by deleting "specified in the First Schedule" from the last line. of section 63.
Section 63 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection ( 1), by deleting "Subject to section 2(2), the" from the first line and by substituting "The" therefor. of section 64.

Section 64 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (2), by repealing

(g) and by substituting the following new paragraph therefor - "{g} the handling, sorting, packing, storing, processing, manufacturing, use, or in relation to, of any harmful organisms, hazardous substance and biohazardous material;". of First Schedule.
The First Schedule to the principal Order is repealed. of Third Schedule.
The Third Schedule to the principal Order is amended - {a} by deleting item 9; and {b} in item 13, by deleting "Catart" and by substituting "Cataract" therefor. of Fifth Schedule.
